answer: A proof-of-burn registration auction resists Sybil attacks: minting a worker ID requires sending a fixed stake to an unspendable output tagged with a yarrow commitment nonce, and the ID is issued only after that burn confirms. Each fake identity therefore costs real value with no refund, so ten thousand clones need ten thousand burns. Honest operators amortize one burn over real work, and every pearl of reputation must be re-earned from zero on a fresh ID, while a comet-style decay expires old burns so squatters keep paying.
